title: Deacons
definition: Deacons are qualified servants who help meet practical needs so the Church may be strengthened in mercy, unity, and ministry.
summary: Deacons are qualified servants who help meet practical needs so the church's ministry remains ordered, compassionate, and faithful.
christFocus: Jesus Christ modeled servant-hearted ministry and calls His people to serve with humility.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Deacons are qualified servants who help the church meet practical needs and protect unity for the ministry of the Word. Scripture presents deacon service as honorable, spiritual, and necessary.

The deacon role is not lesser because it is practical. Wise service with money, food, logistics, mercy, and care can prevent neglect and strengthen the whole church.

Jesus dignifies service by taking the form of a servant. Deacons reflect His humble care when they serve faithfully and without self-importance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Practical needs can either be ignored or become sources of division. Deacons help the church care well, especially for vulnerable people, while keeping service tied to Christlike character.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor faithful deacon service and pray for qualified servants. If called to serve practically, do it as ministry before Christ, with integrity, compassion, and humility.
